home.title: Professional Forms Engine
home.subtitle: A new multilingual forms layer for Arabic, Persian, and English with autosave, print preview, and ready-to-use templates.
home.localAssetsOnly: All assets are local with no CDN usage.
home.rpcOnly: All write operations go through RPC only.

builder.title: Trilingual Forms Builder
builder.subtitle: Supports instant switching between Arabic, Persian, and English while preserving current input and applying the correct font, direction, numbers, and calendar rules per language.
builder.autosaveEvery15: Autosaves every 15 seconds and keeps a recoverable version history.

currentSaveState.error: Save failed — review RPC or network

builder.selectFieldHint: Select a field from the canvas or add a new field to start editing.
builder.previewDescription: This preview is meant to match the final print output before publish or approval.
builder.emptyCanvasTitle: Start dragging fields into the canvas
builder.emptyCanvasHint: Or choose a ready-made template from the side panel.
builder.dragHint: Use the (+) button or drag fields into the canvas, then reorder them by drag and drop or the ↑ ↓ controls.
builder.localDraftRecovered: A local draft for this form was found and restored automatically.
builder.manualSaveDone: A new manual draft version was saved successfully.
builder.signatureFallbackNote: 2D fallback is ready for printing or when WebGL fails.
